title: Take Log Entry
description: One row per Suno generation take — the learning-loop's raw event log (D5). Deliberately includes kill/rework verdicts alongside keeps: negative data is what a real learning loop needs most, and the prior state of this system had none. The FrankX aggregator (aggregate-take-stats.mjs) reads an array of these entries to produce schemas/take-stats.schema.json. This file is the hub's schema authority for the learning loop; the FrankX ingest/take-logging path writes against it, never the other way around.

sunoId.description: Generation-platform id (Suno UUID) for this specific take. Identity key — never title-slug (Suno's duplicate-title default guarantees slug collisions).

prompt.description: The exact prompt text submitted to Suno for this take.

guardianIntent.description: Guardian id (data/arcanea-guardians.json) this take was targeted for at generation time, if canon-bound. May differ from the post-hoc measured canon-tag — that delta is prediction-accountability data (D5).

bpm.description: Tempo targeted by the prompt for this take.

mode.description: Key/mode targeted, e.g. 'D minor', or a named Suno generation mode.

verdict.description: Frank's human verdict on this take — the central learning signal. 'rework' and 'kill' are not failures to discard; they are the data the keep-rate ledger needs to bias future prompt-packs away from what doesn't work.
